images.prompt: A Renaissance fresco in the style of Raphael and Michelangelo, painterly, rich natural colours, visible fresco texture and fine cracks, magazine-ad quality. On soft painted clouds in the middle of the picture, two robed winged angels seen from behind lower one large modern tablet computer, held upright between them, toward a marble terrace where a few robed scholars stand in profile with their heads turned away, looking up at it. The tablet's screen is plain glowing white, completely blank, large in the frame and facing the viewer straight on. No faces are visible. The top 35% of the frame is empty painted sky with soft clouds and warm light. Natural colours, no green tint. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.
